summary.one_liner: A ComfyUI custom node package for Decart's Lucy Edit model, which applies text-instructed edits (outfits, character swaps, object insertion, scene changes) to videos while keeping motion and composition.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides ComfyUI custom nodes for Lucy Edit, a video editing model driven by free-text instructions. It supports clothing and accessory changes, character replacement (for example turning a person into an animal or cartoon character), object insertion and replacement, and scene or style transformations. The README says the model preserves motion and composition, and that common edits need no masks or finetuning. Two paths are described: an API-based node (Lucy Edit Pro) using a workflow file and an API key, and local inference (Lucy Edit Dev) using downloaded weights. The README includes a prompting guide with trigger words (Change, Add, Replace, Transform to), per-edit-type reliability notes, and a sample system prompt for using an LLM to enhance prompts. Recommended prompts are about 20-30 descriptive words, and 81-frame clips are said to give better temporal consistency.
use_cases: change outfits or accessories in a video
replace a person with a character or creature in footage
insert objects into a video clip
swap the scene or background of a video with a text prompt
apply a cartoon or anime style to video
prototype video edits locally in ComfyUI
how_to_run: Clone this repo into the ComfyUI custom_nodes folder.
Download the FP16 or FP32 Lucy Edit weights (links not shown in the README text).
For local use, load examples/basic-lucy-edit-dev.json in ComfyUI.
For the API version, load examples/basic-api-lucy-edit.json and add an API key from Decart.
notable: Text-only instruction editing of video with motion and composition preserved, no masks needed for common edits
Two modes: API-based Lucy Edit Pro and local Lucy Edit Dev weights
README includes a prompting guide with trigger words and per-edit reliability ratings
Includes a system prompt for LLM-based prompt enhancement
Lucy Edit 1.1 Dev weights were released in November 2025
caveats: Model weights use a non-commercial community license; commercial use requires contacting Decart
Pro mode needs an API key from Decart; local mode needs downloaded model weights
Reliability varies: color changes are mixed, adding objects often attaches to the subject, and global transformations may change the subject's identity
Roadmap item for Lucy Edit Dev/Image API support is still unchecked
